set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Inventory user-visible features added after the original plotting comparison and classify each as visual, structural, or nonvisual.
- Add deterministic automated visual contracts for uncovered visual features, with failure artifacts suitable for review.
- Compare plotting semantics with independently rendered ggplot2 references where its grammar is the closest peer; use cross-backend Intaglio parity or protocol/standards assertions where those are more relevant.
- Generate a human-review HTML gallery and manifest that state what should and should not match.
- Run focused visual QA, repository formatting, and affected-platform tests with exact evidence.
set.title: [Intaglio 1.0][Assurance] Add visual QA for recent plotting and backend features
